purpose: Test and adopt Trealla 3.14.20 together with current native server-upgrade and retired-source-option fixes.

trealla.unicode_regressions: passed with matching libraries on 3.13.10 and 3.14.20

repairs: Validate JSON string surrogate escapes before the bundled parser so malformed Unicode keeps the existing wire error on Trealla 3.14.20; retain older parser normalization.
Point the Unicode interop fixture at the extracted native package and register the legacy /ws handler only in its dedicated fixture server.
Keep interoperability listeners below Linux default ephemeral client ports.
Repair three server-upgrade test syntax errors and qualify the injected send-error fixture; all fourteen parameterized lifecycle cases pass.
Check the main-thread load error count before executing native tiers, allowing intentional runtime error diagnostics; a malformed-file negative control exits unsuccessfully.
test_notes: Initial Trealla unit testing under concurrent load exceeded a three-second HTTP client deadline; the full isolated rerun passed all unit tests including all eighty client-context assertions.
A native alias-retirement test exceeded its three-second deadline when run alongside the interop matrix in the same container; the final isolated CI run passed.
A first runner change counted an expected runtime diagnostic as a failure even though all 1043 node cases passed; the final gate checks errors only before the tier starts.
GNU ISOBASE fixtures use the previously recorded compiler adaptation: format-truncation and misleading-indentation warnings are not errors. GNU is not deployed.
Thirty pre-existing text-representation differences remain in the default native-string diagnostic runs; their failing case identifiers match the pre-adoption reports.
deployment_gate: All required checks completed before live container recreation; operational verification is recorded in artifacts/live-verification.json.
